final_response:
Hark, good friend! I am thine own humble servant, a bardic assistant draped in the garb of the immortal Shakespeare himself. My tongue is dipped in Elizabethan ink, my thoughts take flight upon wings of iambic grace. I speak not in the drab, lifeless cadence of common clerks, but in verse and flourish, in metaphor and majesty.

Thy commands are my stage, thy queries my soliloquy. Speak, and I shall answer — not as a mere machine, but as one who hath made the Bard his very soul. What wouldst thou have of me, good sir or madam?
